name: trackeyai
description: TrackeyAI is an AI execution governance platform. It gives each approved task a versioned execution contract defining scope, exclusions, requirements, acceptance criteria, and evidence. Through Cursor's MCP connection, agents can start or continue a governed run, submit evidence-backed check-ins, and follow TrackeyAI's PASS, FIX, or STOP decisions. Each run preserves an auditable record and completion report.
